character.motivation: Mends nets, notices who stopped bringing them, and refuses to let Hollis quietly retire from everybody's life.
character.backstory: Bea kept the ferry nets working through the evacuation, then watched Hollis leave his best net untouched when the crossings stopped. She has been setting aside a matching length of cord for years.
character.quest_hook: Ask Hollis what he wants the mended net to be used for, then help Bea finish it for that purpose.

dialogue.introduction: If I mend your net, bring it back dirty. I'd like to know you actually used it.
dialogue.friendship: Hollis never asks me to mend his best net. He hangs it by the door as if someone might still knock for it.
dialogue.supper: I brought a fishing net to hold the rolls. Mara says if I bring it again she'll line it with a clean cloth.
dialogue.hearing: I've started mending Hollis's best net. He hasn't asked me to stop.
dialogue.favorite_gift: Excellent. I can lay the wet net on that instead of the floorboards.
dialogue.disliked_gift: Sweet flowers near a drying net attract the wrong sort of company.

routine.home_context: Lives next to Hollis so she can mend nets with him if he ever brings his out again.
